About us

Specialists in granite, quartz and marble supply

Musha weGranite supplies and installs natural stone for homes, offices and memorials. Every piece is cut to your measurements, polished to a mirror finish and fitted with care.

From a single window cill to a complete kitchen, we bring quality stone, elegant spaces and lasting value to every job.

  • Cutting to size, polishing and fitting
  • Black, rusty yellow, grey and Ross brown granite
  • Marble and quartz in various colours

Questions

Frequently asked questions

Which stones do you supply?

Black, rusty yellow, grey and Ross brown granite, and various colours of marble and quartz.

Do you cut and fit the stone?

Yes. We cut to size, polish and fit.

What can you make?

Kitchen tops, counter tops, window cills, tiles, stair cases, outdoor furniture, vanities and tombstones.

How do I get an exact price?

Message us on WhatsApp with your measurements and preferred stone and we will quote you.

Are the prices final?

The listed prices are starting prices from our catalogue. The final cost depends on size, colour and design.

Let us shape your stone

Message us on WhatsApp for a quote. We value your presence and look forward to serving you.
